rationale: Every sub-10 ns run used timing-driven placement with a target <=0.62 of default; loose targets (0.93-0.98) leave T_eff near 11.5-12 ns, and non-TD or AREA 2 runs stall near 12 even when tight. Best is md5's recipe (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, TD, post-GRT timing+design repair, cap213, ~0.50 target): 8.917. Every run meets hold, DRC and slew/cap, leaving room to push. Setting 1 keeps that recipe but raises utilisation to 35 (shorter wires; util 40 routed DRC-free), targets slightly tighter and raises setup margins. Setting 2 is md5's recipe with only synthesis changed to DELAY 3 (bm64's DELAY 3 reached 9.6 without post-GRT timing repair), testing whether faster logic helps given the strong backend.
